gloss: to fall asleep, to go to sleep

definitions.gloss: to fall asleep, to go to sleep
definitions.explanation: To transition from being awake to being asleep.
To become ill and confined to bed.

examples.japanese: なかなか{寝付|ねつ}けなかった。
{子供|こども}がやっと{寝付|ねつ}いた。
{暑|あつ}くて{寝付|ねつ}きが{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: It's so hot that I have trouble falling asleep.
examples.notes: [Note: {寝付|ねつ}き is the noun form meaning 'ability to fall asleep']

notes:
{寝付|ねつ}く is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to fall asleep.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {寝|ね}る (to sleep) + {付|つ}く (to attach, to settle) → to settle into sleep

ASPECT (ている):
{寝付|ねつ}いている indicates a state of being asleep (having fallen asleep).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- なかなか{寝付|ねつ}けない (can't fall asleep easily)
- やっと{寝付|ねつ}いた (finally fell asleep)
- {寝付|ねつ}きがいい/悪い (easy/hard to fall asleep)
- すぐに{寝付|ねつ}く (fall asleep quickly)

RELATED NOUN:
- {寝付|ねつ}き: the ability to fall asleep; {寝付|ねつ}きがいい = falls asleep easily

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {眠|ねむ}る: to sleep (more general)
- {寝|ね}る: to go to bed, to sleep
- {寝付|ねつ}く specifically refers to the act of falling asleep

[Register: Neutral]
